subheading: CLINICAL FEATURES OF PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASE
subheading_corrected: CLINICAL FEATURES OF PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASE
text:
CLINICAL FEATURES OF PERIPHERAL VASCULAR DISEASE
- Hair loss on the feet and legs and brittle toenails
- Intermittent claudication
- Numbness in the legs.
- Sores or ulcers on the legs and feet that take a long time to heal
- Difficulty in finding a pulse in the leg or foot.
- Erectile dysfunction
